beats.say: 73 goals: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or.
That tally came across club and country during the 2025 26 campaign.
That works out at roughly a goal every three days across the whole season.
Before Kane only four Englishmen had ever lifted the Ballon d'Or trophy before.
The ceremony took place on 26 October at the historic London Palladium venue.
On the same night Alexia Putellas won the Women's award for the third time.
Kane edged out Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal in the final voting count.
His 73 goals for club and country powered him to the top spot.
Kane now joins four other Englishmen on the Ballon d'Or list, at long last. Who is your favourite winner?

facts: Harry Kane scored 73 goals for club and country during the 2025-26 season.
Harry Kane won the Men's Ballon d'Or for the first time in his career.
Alexia Putellas won the Women's Ballon d'Or for the third time in her career.
The ceremony took place on 26 October 2026 at the London Palladium in London.
Only four other Englishmen have won the Ballon d'Or before Harry Kane.
Kane finished ahead of Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal in the voting.
